verdict.rationale: Poke's own docs say external services such as GitHub, CI/CD pipelines or monitoring tools can trigger Poke via its API when something happens (poke-docs-1, poke-docs-2). Its Recipes feature is described as a way to 'easily set up automations' (poke-docs-28), with prebuilt automation recipes such as Linear (poke-docs-32). That gives real event-to-action automation, but the docs never show a way to author explicit rules that fire actions automatically. Missing for 10: a documented rule or trigger builder (event conditions mapped to actions), detail on which built-in events Poke can watch on its own, and hands-on or independent confirmation that event-triggered automations run reliably.
